aid.value: International admission is need-sensitive. Plan to demonstrate at least $35,000 yearly contribution, described as the average gap after scholarship, not a guaranteed net price. Submit CSS; if unavailable, request Hendrix ISFAA from admissions. No universal full-need/full-ride promise is approved.

attributes.aidShort: Need-sensitive; plan at least $35,000 yearly family contribution

evidence.quote: need sensitive admission policy for international students

testing.value: Hendrix's own Common App profile lists first-year SAT/ACT optional/flexible review and self-reported scores. Non-native speakers still need English evidence; SAT/ACT English scores are one accepted alternative, not a universal entrance-exam requirement.

english.value: Non-native speakers submit official English evidence: older TOEFL 94, IELTS 7.0, DET 115, SAT reading/writing 730+ or ACT English 32+. No new-scale TOEFL minimum or general English-medium waiver is published here; confirm before relying on one.

evidence.quote: Non-native English speakers must submit an official score report

fee.value: Hendrix's exact Common App profile lists no first-year application fee. CSS, English tests, visa/SEVIS and enrollment charges are separate, not automatically waived.

evidence.quote: Charges no application fee - First Year

deadline.value: International fall: application/materials May 12, enrollment fee May 21, first-year I-20 documents priority May 31/final June 15. Spring: application/materials October 14, enrollment fee October 23, first-year I-20 documents November 9. Transfer SEVIS dates differ. The page does not label an entry year; confirm cycle and round before applying. These final international dates are not domestic early-round deadlines.

aid.value: Agnes Scott offers international merit, not need-based aid, and does not accept CSS/ISFAA. The new Fall 2027 $100K+ Promise explicitly includes international entrants and promises at least $25,000 yearly renewable merit. But https://www.agnesscott.edu/admission/undergraduate-admission/international-students/index.html still says RD merit is not guaranteed, and the requirements page describes competitive awards. Confirm guarantee eligibility and scholarship timing before relying on it. Renewal requires award-specific academic standing; insurance/indirect costs and break housing/meals are separate. No full-cost promise is approved. The institution describes itself as an inclusive women's college; confirm eligibility individually.

testing.value: International SAT/ACT submissions are optional, with merit consideration regardless of submitting scores. English-language evidence is separate; SAT/ACT English results may meet that requirement without making SAT/ACT compulsory for everyone.

evidence.quote: The submission of SAT or ACT scores is optional for international applicants.

english.value: Non-native speakers need English evidence. Published minima: older TOEFL 80 (MyBest accepted), IELTS 6.5, DET 110, Cambridge 176, ELS Level 12 or SAT verbal/ACT English 520/20. No new-scale TOEFL minimum is stated. Alternatives include native English from listed countries, qualifying US associate degree, US high-school graduation after three continuous years, or GCSE/IGCSE English Language C (not ESL). Required documents must be official/attested, not ordinary scanned copies. Confirm individual eligibility and accepted delivery.

evidence.quote: Agnes Scott accepts TOEFL MyBest Score.

fee.value: International applicants pay a non-waivable $30 application fee. Generic domestic fee-waiver claims must not override this international instruction. English exams, visa and the non-refundable enrollment deposit are separate.

deadline.value: The Fall 2027 international timetable gives ED November 1, EA I November 15, EA II January 16 and RD March 15; ED deposit December 15, other deposits May 1. https://www.agnesscott.edu/admission/undergraduate-admission/scholarships-financial-aid/100k-promise.html instead gives January 15 for EA II/scholarship priority. Confirm January 15 versus 16 and RD merit eligibility with admissions; do not silently select the later date. These are first-year dates, not transfer deadlines.
